computer.tech_slot_note: Four computer tech slots sit behind spaces 1, 3, 5 and 6 (read from the picture on rulebook p.14). A tech slot adds a lower space under its top space.

slot_note: Probe and telescope techs go on their own slot, one per technology. The slot positions print the same four pictures as the stacks on the tech board.
